nodes.name: GND
nodes.semantic_role: System common ground with analog/digital star-ground intent

nodes.name: power_boost
nodes.description: MT3608 boost converter stepping up external USB_5V to VBOOST_9V to supply the NE5532 preamplifier. EN pin tied to VIN for always-on operation. Requires external inductor, catch diode, and feedback resistor divider to set 9V output.

nodes.name: SW
nodes.description: Power switch output, drain of internal MOSFET, connects to inductor and output rectifier, swings between GND and 28V

nodes.name: GND
nodes.description: Ground pin, connect to strong ground plane for heat sinking

nodes.name: FB
nodes.description: Feedback input, 0.6V reference voltage, connect resistor divider for output voltage setting

nodes.name: EN
nodes.description: Regulator enable input, active high (VIH>=1.5V, VIL<=0.4V), connect to VIN for automatic startup

nodes.name: VIN
nodes.description: Input supply pin, operating range 2V-24V, must be locally bypassed with capacitor

nodes.name: NC
nodes.description: No connect, leave floating, do not connect to any net

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 linear regulator stepping down external USB_5V to VCC_3V3. Provides stable logic power for ATmega328P and MCP4725.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P microcontroller powered by VCC_3V3. Controls the MCP4725 DAC over I2C bus (PC4=SDA, PC5=SCL). This module owns the I2C bus pull-up resistors.

nodes.name: dac_gain_ctrl
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit DAC powered by VCC_3V3. Acts as an I2C slave. A0 pin is tied to GND to set the I2C address. VOUT generates the analog GAIN_CTRL signal used to bias or adjust the gain of the downstream preamplifier.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: preamp
nodes.description: NE5532 dual low-noise op-amp configured as a stereo preamplifier. Powered by VBOOST_9V (single-supply configuration, VCC_N tied to GND). Accepts external L/R audio signals and mixes/modulates them with GAIN_CTRL from the DAC through an analog network to provide level-controlled PREAMP_OUT_L and PREAMP_OUT_R signals.

nodes.name: audio_amp
nodes.description: PAM8403 3W stereo Class-D amplifier powered directly by external USB_5V. Receives PREAMP_OUT_L and PREAMP_OUT_R. SHDN and MUTE pins are pulled high to enable output. Drives stereo speakers directly. PGND and analog GND trace separation should meet at the star ground point.

nodes.name: PVDD_1
nodes.description: Power Supply Input for Output Stage (pin 4)

nodes.name: MUTE
nodes.description: Mute Control Input, active low, internal pull-up

nodes.name: VREF
nodes.description: Internal Analog Reference, requires bypass capacitor to GND

nodes.name: SHDN
nodes.description: Shutdown Control Input, active low, internal pull-up

nodes.name: PVDD_2
nodes.description: Power Supply Input for Output Stage (pin 13)
